thread:
cheng: heads-up — deploy-bot paused the promo for release/2026-03-22 (change 12345). staging e2e failing intermittently, and we see artifact shard upload + image unpack slowdowns. holding change window.

deploy-bot: auto-backoff triggered for promo change/12345 at 2026-03-22T09:12:07Z. reason: artifact-shard-upload-slowdown (5m avg) + 3 failing e2e runs. promotion paused.

sanjay: copying logs, short dump below. looks like a combination of slow registry response and a flaky webhook test hitting a 10s timeout.

maria: can we pin to last-good image digest instead of full rollback? that lets consumers keep using stable behaviour and buys time.

cheng: yes, pinning is an option but if the staging tests are flaky we still risk regressions in prod if we force-promo. need clarity on artifact integrity.

emily-oncall: @cheng @sanjay I repro'd the webhook timeout locally once. here's the failing snippet from the e2e run: 

```
E 09:03:12 tests/test_webhook_flow.py::test_retry_backoff - AssertionError: expected 200 but got 504
W 09:03:13 http.client: Retrying POST https://registry.internal/_shards/abc123 (attempt 4) - status=504
```

emily-oncall: also saw registry slowups during shard uploads, correlates with instance autoscaler churning two nodes earlier.

sanjay: digging into registry metrics now — there was a brief GC pause on the replica set. upload latency spiked ~6m. we have partial artifacts in the shard index but checksums look fine.

maria: if checksums are clean, pin-ing the digest for the promo should be safe. the risk is a delayed fix and then a rollback later if unrelated regression pops up.

cheng: decision options: (A) rollback change 12345 to last-promoted commit; (B) pin image digest for immediate promo and rerun e2e in a controlled window; (C) wait and rerun after infra fixes.

deploy-bot: suggested action: mark promo paused -> manual-review required. available actions: rollback | pin | rerun. use `/deploy action <id> <choice>` to proceed.

emily-oncall: my recommendation: pin digest and rerun the failed e2e subset with parallelism=1 to avoid masking flakiness. schedule the rerun in the next 15m, still inside today's change window. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sanjay: infra status — I've scaled up one registry replica and bumped upload request timeout. metrics look steady now (p90 upload latency down from 12s to 300ms).

maria: ok, if registry is stable and checksums verified, I'm fine pinning. I'll prepare release notes entry noting the temporary pin and follow-up rollback plan.

cheng: let's do this: 1) pin promo to digest sha256:9f8b...c7a (last-good), 2) run e2e subset (webhook tests + smoke) with parallelism=1, 3) if tests pass twice in a row, unpause and promote; if they fail, roll back. emily, can you run the rerun?

emily-oncall: running now: `/deploy action 12345 pin sha256:9f8b...c7a` then `/ci rerun e2e --tests webhook_flow,smoke --parallelism 1`

deploy-bot: action accepted: pin applied for change/12345 -> sha256:9f8b...c7a. promo still paused pending test verdict.

emily-oncall: first rerun started 09:28Z. ETA ~8m. will post results.

(8m later)
emily-oncall: rerun result: webhook_flow ✓, smoke ✓. rerunning once more to be safe.

emily-oncall: rerun #2 result: webhook_flow ✓, smoke ✓. all green.

maria: pushing release notes draft: "Temporarily pinned release/2026-03-22 to sha256:9f8b...c7a due to intermittent staging webhook timeouts and registry shard upload latency. Follow-up: will monitor registry GC behavior and revert pin once we validate end-to-end stability."

cheng: consensus reached. unpausing and promoting now. deploy-bot, proceed with promotion to canary.

deploy-bot: promotion started to canary ring. will cascade per usual rollout policy. notify #incidents if any anomalies. :rocket:

sanjay: filing infra ticket to investigate GC and autoscaler churn root cause: INFRA-9876. tagging for postmortem.

emily-oncall: noted — I'll close this thread after the canary window completes. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
